name: Sayagata
description: Sayagata: interlocking manji keys drawn as one continuous fret across the cloth.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 40%, 60% 40%, 60% 0, 78% 0, 78% 58%, 0 58%); clip-path: polygon(0 40%, 60% 40%, 60% 0, 78% 0, 78% 58%, 0 58%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(100% 42%, 40% 42%, 40% 100%, 22% 100%, 22% 24%, 100% 24%); clip-path: polygon(100% 42%, 40% 42%, 40% 100%, 22% 100%, 22% 24%, 100% 24%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
